description: This file defines classes and types related to network requests, responses, and WebSocket handling within the Playwright core library, including request interception, header management, and request/response lifecycle management.

classes.name: Request
classes.description: Represents an HTTP request, including headers, method, URL, and lifecycle management.

classes.name: Response
classes.description: Represents an HTTP response, including status, headers, body, and security details.

classes.name: Route
classes.description: Handles request interception, aborting, fulfilling, and continuing requests.

classes.name: WebSocket
classes.description: Represents a WebSocket connection, handling message sending, receiving, and lifecycle.

classes.name: WebSocketRoute
classes.description: Manages WebSocket route interception and message handling.

classes.name: WebSocketRouteHandler
classes.description: Defines a handler for WebSocket route interception with pattern matching.

classes.name: RouteHandler
classes.description: Manages request/response route handling, including stop and expiration logic.

classes.name: RawHeaders
classes.description: Manages HTTP headers in raw form, supporting case-insensitive access and multiple values.

methods.name: headers
methods.description: Returns headers as a Headers object.

methods.name: headersArray
methods.description: Returns headers as an array of name-value pairs.

methods.name: headerValue
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a specific header.

methods.name: body
methods.description: Returns the response body as a Buffer.

methods.name: text
methods.description: Returns the response body as a UTF-8 string.

methods.name: json
methods.description: Parses and returns the response body as JSON.

methods.name: connectToServer
methods.description: Establishes a connection to the WebSocket server.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends a message over the WebSocket.

methods.name: onMessage
methods.description: Sets a handler for incoming WebSocket messages.

methods.name: onClose
methods.description: Sets a handler for WebSocket close events.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the route handler, optionally ignoring errors.

methods.name: matches
methods.description: Checks if a URL matches the route pattern.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Executes the route handler for a given route.

methods.name: prepareInterceptionPatterns
methods.description: Prepares URL patterns for request interception.
